sentences.text: 1  4 - The Sub Divisional Officer (Rev.) Cum Competent Officer (Under The  Land Acquisition) Sub Division Aarang, District Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

Respondents For Petitioners : Mr. Arun Kumar Shukla, Advocate For Respondent No.2 : Mr. Dhiraj Wankhede,
Advocate S.B.: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge Order on Board 11/09/2024 1.

Learned counsel for respondent No.2 raises an objection with regard to maintainability of the writ petition on the ground that petitioners raised a grievance with respect to enhancement of amount of compensation which can be entertained and considered by the Arbitrator under Section 3 G(5) of the National Highways Act 1956 (for short "Act of 1956").
2.

After arguing for some time, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in view of objection raised by learned counsel for respondent, he may be permitted to withdraw this writ petition with liberty to avail remedy as provided under the Act of 1956.
3. In view of submission of learned counsel for the petitioners this writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with the liberty as prayed for.
In the event petitioners approach the authority by way of filing appropriate proceedings, the concerned authority shall consider and decide the same expeditiously in a accordance with law.

SSd/-
